name: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
title: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
description:
Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports. 



ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with the proprietary polish and anodizing process. 



AN to Metric adapter or union fittings allow you to connect two female fitting points together, one metric and one AN flare end side. 



These Adapters make a perfect fit and seal to the AN Fittings, which are specifically designed for use with the e85 and race-fuel compatible Nylon Braided Hoses.



For a hassle-free installation process, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the Fitting Assembly Tools. Please use the Reference Video for proper installation procedures.
